ctx.x: put $1,000.00 down." I said, "Well, okay." So I said, "If you like it, okay." So she says, -- now the fella was a builder and he had started part of it inside. It was just like -- the interior was inside, but it had to be finished off like with some of the rooms and things the way you wanted it. So she says, "I just told him I wanted it as it was, because his daughter was going to live with him and he's going to fix her like another -- so they ended up -- when we ended up, we had 20 rooms in this house and of…

So I bought 12 more lots and I gave my daughter four and she built next to me, so we got like eight more that's right on the side of her. So they're not that close to us, you know, although people -- they've built in since then. If I had had a little more money -- actually, if I had listened to my wife, I'd have been rich. I really should have listened to her. They had the log cabins -- some German people lived right next to us and so they knew Fred Stones. They were old people and they would come out in the…

with two white ladies, they had a nursing home. One wanted to buy the other two out and so my wife said -- she sold out and the other white lady sold out. So now right next to us are 17 lots, Gary, with two log cabins, beautiful log cabin houses on them, and the lady says, "Oh, it would be so nice for you all." She said, "Because we're old and it's --" she says, "It's a problem for us to come from Brooklyn out here and to keep it clean." And they kept it spotless, you know?
